faq.question: What does Surya mean?

faq.question: What is the origin of Surya?

faq.question: Is Surya an Arabic name?
faq.answer: No — the underlying form is Sanskrit, not Arabic.

faq.question: Is Surya an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Surya can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Sanskrit-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
